UI_PZMM_app_changed: PZMM changed your mods since you opened this screen.
UI_PZMM_bisect_found: Found it: %1 causes the problem. Your mod list is restored.
UI_PZMM_bisect_found_group: It's in this group: %1. These mods need each other, so they were tested together: turn off the ones nothing else needs, one at a time, to find which. Your mod list is restored.
UI_PZMM_bisect_needs_two: Enable at least two mods to search for a broken one.
UI_PZMM_bisect_none: The problem still happens with every suspect off, so it isn't one of these mods. Your mod list is restored.
UI_PZMM_bisect_one_group: Your enabled mods all need each other (%1), so the search can't split them into groups to test: turn some off by hand to narrow it down.
UI_PZMM_bisect_together: %1 breaks it only together with mods in another group: turning it off fixes your list, but it's fine on its own. Your mod list is restored.
UI_PZMM_check_broken_hint: The game won't load these, or won't start
UI_PZMM_details_first_seen_tip: When this mod arrived on this PC, as far as PZMM can tell. It can reset if Steam downloads the mod again.
UI_PZMM_details_newer: A newer version is on the Workshop.
UI_PZMM_details_source_pzmm: Workshop: PZMM's copy of a Workshop item

All

UI_PZMM_ghost_warn: This mod is enabled in your profile but isn't installed. Install it, subscribe to it in Steam, or disable it.
UI_PZMM_home_first_mods: No mods on yet: pick some in the Workshop.

UI_PZMM_home_server_info_sub: Its mods and settings, in Servers

UI_PZMM_maps_pack: 1 of %1 mods in this Workshop item
UI_PZMM_maps_req_none: The shown maps need nothing else.
UI_PZMM_mods_empty_hint: Subscribe to mods in Steam: subscriptions show up here once you Rescan.
UI_PZMM_notice_feed: change notes and their history, and loading the notes for more mods.
UI_PZMM_notice_home: Featured from The Indie Stone and its news, the Workshop picture on each update, starting a hosted server, and its Stopped, Starting and Crashed states.
UI_PZMM_notice_java: setting up, repairing or removing ZombieBuddy, scanning inside each jar, checking each jar's signature, approving Java mods, setting up Project Viewpoint, other Java loaders and copying a jar's SHA-256.
UI_PZMM_notice_make: checking any mod folder and building its upload folder.
UI_PZMM_notice_maps: the world picture and hiding the game's map, installing a map's missing requirements, a mod ID in two items, a background picture, the Workshop maps source in the list (Map-tagged items you haven't installed, with its scan and Stop, an Install on those rows and in Compare), searching maps by tag, checking Workshop maps you haven't installed and subscriber counts (Steam's details don't give them).
UI_PZMM_notice_mods: installing from a zip, folder, GitHub or a link, removing a mod and rolling one back, change notes in a mod's details, the game's error log, profiles (new, rename, copy, delete), snapshots and pinning a mod's place, importing a profile (a share code, a Workshop collection or another manager's list), removing unused server profiles and setting up Project Viewpoint, download history, reinstall and cancel, unsubscribing on the Workshop page, subscriber count, Mod ID matches and listed by the author in details, the launch pre-flight check (fix and play, launch anyway, turn off those mods, trust files, don't ask again), the Check setup findings the game doesn't raise (the code risk scan with its risk tier and trust files, a Workshop item that is gone, banned or hidden, Lua syntax errors, duplicate copies and mod.info problems; server config findings: mods missing from or extra in a server's ini, build and requirement mismatches; game and launcher checks: the game's jar and classes, the launch flag, Java options, ZombieBuddy changed or broken, folders that don't exist; and map folder and overlap findings) and the desktop-only Check setup fixes (switch build, find a B42 version, verify game files, remove the extra copy, unsubscribe the others, get the original, update the game).
UI_PZMM_notice_saves: backup screenshots, managing backups (delete, rename, named slots), automatic backups, Copy as and Copy with my mods (the game can't copy folders), repairing empty map files, characters' positions and data, the sandbox editor, the Data tab, deleted saves and listing other broken files.
UI_PZMM_notice_servers: running a dedicated server (setup, start, stop, console, players, backups and files), hosting beyond start and stop (restart, a warned restart with abort, updating, adopting or finding an existing server, checking the Workshop for external servers, copying diagnostics), hosting tabs (automation with crash and scheduled restarts, warnings, backups every N and the Discord bot and relay; world tools to copy a world, reset chunks or migrate; a mods editor that adds from a collection, profile or preset, autosorts and checks conflicts; the ini settings editor with presets), remote servers (RCON, FTP and the Files tab), the public join address and opening pzmm:// links, a profile per server, the country filter and its setting, listing servers without Steam (a Steam Web API key), your Steam friends' servers, a server's player list, restoring a past join's setup and, in the join dialog, map overlap and maps-not-in-mods warnings, per-mod size and updated date, server keywords, a caution for a very recent update and Remember password (the game can't ask a server who is online).
UI_PZMM_notice_settings: language, the game build override, notifications and the tray, folders, downloads and updates, accounts and keys, removal and backup options, theme and accent, launch options, Performance (memory, JVM arguments, PZOpt, the largest mods), the Workshop links open in Steam or the browser setting, the server-country setting, the app's update check, autosorting new mods, autostart, which page the Workshop opens on, results per page, re-downloading the mods PZMM installed, keeping favourites on and hidden mods off in every profile, and a profile's own game folder (its saves, options and logs kept apart).
UI_PZMM_notice_workshop: browsing the Workshop with filters, tags, sorting and pages, an item's stars, comments and pictures, making a profile from a collection, the mods-by-this-author and mods-that-need drill-downs, the item's change-notes tab, Collections with this item (that needs Workshop queries), its description, subscriber, visitor and favourite counts and tags, the Workshop's Home view (popular this week, most subscribed, newest, recently updated, most required), and removing an installed item.
UI_PZMM_order_drag_hint: Drag to reorder. Enter or double-click opens a mod.
UI_PZMM_order_lede: Mods load top to bottom. When two change the same file, the lower one wins. The library is yours to organise: its order doesn't change this one.
UI_PZMM_promo_ask: Give it a thumbs-up on the Workshop
UI_PZMM_set_favfirst: Favourites at the top of sorted and filtered lists
UI_PZMM_set_lede: This screen's options. PZMM's Settings write the same file.
UI_PZMM_sorry_get: To use them, install the desktop app:
UI_PZMM_sorry_open: They're in the PZMM app: Open in PZMM takes you there.
UI_PZMM_sorry_title: We're sorry! Because of limits on what mods can do in the game, some features are missing here.
UI_PZMM_srv_and_more: and %1 more: the server runs %2 mods, but only the first few show outside the game
UI_PZMM_srv_build_mismatch: This server runs %1; you play Build %2. Joining fails until you play the same build.
UI_PZMM_srv_getting_list: Getting the server list from Steam...
UI_PZMM_srv_history_hint: Your last join of this server, from PZMM's list. Restoring a past join's setup, and who is online, are in the PZMM app: the game can't ask a server for either.
UI_PZMM_srv_listed_none: Steam listed no servers. Try Find again.
UI_PZMM_srv_mods_unknown: Its mods show once it answers.
UI_PZMM_srv_more: Showing the first %1: narrow the filters to see the rest.
UI_PZMM_srv_moved_on: %1 was updated on the Workshop after you last joined this server: joining may fail until the server restarts.
UI_PZMM_srv_no_mods: No mods: it runs vanilla Project Zomboid.
UI_PZMM_srv_skipped: %1 mods are ticked off: they aren't downloaded or put in the profile. The server may turn you away, or things from them may be missing.
UI_PZMM_srv_skipped_one: 1 mod is ticked off: it isn't downloaded or put in the profile. The server may turn you away, or things from it may be missing.
UI_PZMM_srv_start_steam: Start Steam and refresh: the Internet list comes from it.
UI_PZMM_srv_wipe_hint: Last wipe is when its world was made: it doesn't change when the server restarts.
